Configuration ​

Config Commands ​

bash
pal config list              # Show all custom settings
pal config get <key>         # Get specific value
pal config set <key> <value> # Set value
pal config reset [key]       # Reset to default(s)

Configuration Keys ​

Display ​

KeyDefaultDescription
logLevelinfoLog level: debug, info, warn, error, silent
themedarkUI theme: light, dark

Network ​

KeyDefaultDescription
portautoLocal seeder port
max_connections100Maximum P2P connections
bandwidth_cap0Upload cap in KB/s (0 = unlimited)
bandwidth_up—Upload limit
bandwidth_down—Download limit
discovery_servers138.2.142.188,92.5.46.86Discovery server IPs (comma-separated, no DNS)
announce_interval3600DHT announce interval (seconds)
dht_bootstrapMainline defaultsBootstrap DHT nodes
stunServersstun:stun.l.google.com:19302STUN server list
turn_servers—TURN relay servers

Storage ​

KeyDefaultDescription
downloadDir~/Downloads/PalexplorerDownload folder

Security ​

KeyDefaultDescription
extensionRequireSignaturetrueRequire Ed25519 signatures on extensions
autoUpdatetrueCheck for updates on startup

Environment Variables ​

VariableDescription
PAL_DATA_DIROverride data directory
PAL_DISCOVERY_URLOverride discovery server
PAL_LOG_LEVELOverride log level
PAL_EXT_SIGNING_KEYOverride extension signing key
NODE_ENVSet to production for stricter security

Precedence ​

  1. CLI flags (highest)
  2. Environment variables (PAL_*)
  3. Config store (JSON)
  4. Hardcoded defaults (lowest)

Config File Location ​

  • Linux: ~/.config/palexplorer-cli/config.json
  • macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/palexplorer-cli/config.json
  • Windows: %APPDATA%/palexplorer-cli/config.json
